verdict.rationale: Cloudflare advertises 'built-in observability' for Workers and operates dedicated Observability and Logpush MCP servers, implying some centralized logging/visibility exists, but the evidence never describes a single unified view combining build, deploy, and runtime logs together. Missing for 10: concrete docs/screens showing build logs + deployment history + runtime logs unified in one dashboard, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this unified experience.
